title: Samsung Electronics 2026 first-quarter earnings release
excerpt: First-quarter sales were KRW 133.9 trillion, operating profit KRW 57.2 trillion, net profit KRW 47.2 trillion, and common-share EPS KRW 7,123.
summary: The issuer release provides current segment economics, earnings, cash, debt, and profitability data used to assess Samsung's operating thesis and balance sheet.
